# sharingu

> A shared company brain for people and their AI tools: one platform (one Cloudflare worker, one database) serves
> every org at its own address, with the app, a REST API and an MCP door; what happens in an org stays in it. Hosted at
> https://agent.ryuklabs.io; every AI connects at https://agent.ryuklabs.io/mcp. Agents file contributions through the
> door (every write is preview, then file); the database holds the truth; every screen reads it live. The door teaches
> its own use: call `whoami` first, then `missing` with a project — each open item carries the exact call that fills it.

## Connect and use

- [INSTALL](docs/INSTALL.md): join an org (§1), start your own on the hosted platform (§2: sign-up by the operator's
  allowlist and one-time code, then /orgs/new), connect a client (§3), run your own on your Cloudflare account (§4) or
  your machine (§5). A seat's key is both its web passphrase and its bearer token; an account's passphrase signs in to
  every org it has a seat in.
- [Door contract](contracts/door.json): all 35 MCP tools and their REST twins — shapes, refusals, annotations.
  Generated; the authoritative tool reference.
- [Release notes](docs/RELEASE-NOTES.md): what changes for a connected client.
- First calls, in order: `whoami` · `missing {project}` · `formats` · `preview {items}` · `file {previewId, items}`.
  Every session after: `updates` first; `ask` asks the owner; `wrap_up` hands over. A connection that reaches several
  orgs names one with `orgSlug` on any call; `whoami` lists them.
